title: Model-pair compatibility contract
description: The shared, versioned preflight several features consume instead of each reimplementing it (diff-model, Experiments, mechanistic diff, Studio Compare, causal bisect) -- see clozn/analysis/pair_compatibility.py. Every dimension reports an explicit state ('same'/'differs'/'unknown', or 'exact'/'differs'/'unknown' for tokenizer) rather than a bare boolean, because different downstream operations have different requirements: per-token comparison needs the tokenizer to match exactly; a residual transplant needs hidden_size to match exactly; a per-head (kqv_out/head_write) transplant needs head_count to match exactly, gated independently of the other two. A value that could not be honestly measured on one or both sides is OMITTED (value_a/value_b), never null-padded -- absence must stay visible. `head_count` is OPTIONAL at this schema version (added additively after v1's initial release): an older stored document that predates it, and its verdict.operations lacking `head_transplant`, both remain valid documents -- see clozn/schemas/__init__.py's immutability rule.

model_ref.description: Identifying facts about one side of the pair. Every field is optional -- omitted, never null, when not known.

tokenizer_contract.description: 'exact' (not 'same') on purpose -- the one dimension with a hard downstream refusal (per-token comparison). 'method' records how the state was determined: a live behavioral probe through two engines, or a static GGUF tokenizer_sha256 digest comparison (no engine needed).

template_contract.description: A template mismatch is a labeled CAVEAT, never a refusal. 'policy_applied' records which rendering policy a caller used (e.g. diff-model's 'reference' vs 'own') when applicable -- omitted for callers with no such policy.

layer_range.description: Writable layer indices are [min, max_exclusive) -- mirrors GgmlAdapter::add_write_state's own gate (engine/core/src/model_ggml.cpp): layer 0 and the final layer are never writable.

writable_layers.description: Per-model writable layer range, present only for the side(s) whose layer_count is known.

verdict.description: 'overall' is a summary; 'operations' is the machine-readable per-question answer a caller should actually branch on -- 'may I do per-token comparison' and 'may I do a residual transplant' have different requirements and can disagree.

operations.description: 'head_transplant' is OPTIONAL at this schema version (added additively -- see the top-level description): a document produced before this addition simply omits it, never carries it as null.
